Title: 2026-07-24 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Abathur ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Slapathur to lack a visual effect for disabled Structures.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Symbiote to have an incorrect name in the Collection and Hero Select screen.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Symbiote to not animate properly in the Collection.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Alexstrasza's Flames of Fury to have incorrect formatting for non-English languages.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Alexstrasza's Preservation to not benefit from Overprotective.

=== Heroes: Chen ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 13
    • A Touch of Honey
      • [Undocumented] Slow increase reduced from 30% to 20%.

=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Once Again the First Time
      • [Undocumented] Echo mimic Basic Attacks damage increased from 45% to 50%.
      • [Undocumented] Echo mimic Sand Blast damage unchanged, equal to 45%.
  • Level 2
    • Chronic Conditions
      • [Undocumented] Slow increased from 20% to 25%.
      • [Undocumented] Movement Speed increased from 20% to 25%.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Chromie's Chronic Conditions to have incorrect formatting for non-English languages.

=== Heroes: Gall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Gall's Bomb's Away to not gain progress.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Gall's Double Trouble to have incorrect wording.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Reward from Gall's Double Trouble to give less cooldown reduction than intended.

=== Heroes: Genji ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Genji's Deflect to show incorrect cooldown reduction values.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the targeting guide for Jaina's Frostbolt to be incorrect.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Nazeebo's Voodoo Ritual to not gain progress via damage over time from Abilities.

=== Heroes: Qhira ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Qhira's Baseline Quest in the Buff bar to show its cap.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the simple tooltip for Qhira's Fatal Wounds to not show correctly.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Reward from Qhira's Baseline Quest to require Fatal Wounds.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 20
    • Heroic Difficulty
      • [Undocumented] Cooldown reduction reduced from 110 to 90 seconds.

=== Heroes: Valeera ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Valeera's Stealth to not animate properly in the Collection.

=== Heroes: Whitemane ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Whitemane's Inquisitor's Prayer to restore Mana without taking the Talent.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Whitemane's Inquisitor's Prayer to restore Mana even when not hitting enemy Heroes.

=== Heroes: Yrel ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Light of Karabor
      • [Undocumented] Healing bonus when hitting one enemy Hero reduced from 45% to 40%.
      • [Undocumented] Healing bonus when hitting more than one enemy Hero reduced from 90% to 80%.
